colors.line: In their clothes of many colors
stanza: And his subjects gathered 'round him
Like the leaves around a tree
In their clothes of many colors
For the angry gods to see

colors.line: I only see two or three colors
stanza: Oh Randy, leave it up to me
I'll pour the water if you bring the tree
Nothing looks that real to me
I only see two or three colors

colors.line: And we'll fill in the missing colors
stanza: I'm going to find myself a girl
Who can show me what laughter means
And we'll fill in the missing colors
In each other's paint-by-number dreams
And then we'll put our dark glasses on
And we'll make love until our strength is gone
And when the morning light comes streaming in
We'll get up and do it again
Get it up again
All the snow has turned to water
Christmas days have come and gone
Broken toys and faded colors
Are all that's left to linger on
